The main primary tree contains substantive semantics, well-formedness/proof modules, transformation correctness, SMT encoders, language front/back ends and support metaprogramming; Scripts other than the test main are retained because they implement source/IR generation and analysis tooling.

The source checkout retains all documentation and runner material outside primary mathematical search.

review_evidence: grep -LE 'theorem|lemma|def |structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom|elab|syntax|macro|@\[' over exactly the 577 in-scope files: 105 files with none of these keywords.

Classified all 105 by presence of Strata's custom DSL/test command syntax (#strata|#eval|#guard|#check): 103 are genuine executable Strata/Laurel test files using this embedded-DSL syntax (which a naive theorem/def/... grep cannot see), and 2 are pure module-import umbrella files (Strata/DL/Imperative.lean, StrataLaurel/Implementation/Grammar.lean) containing only a `module` line and `public import` statements, no declarations -- retained per FILTER-007 (navigation, not filterable) since this review cannot establish an end-to-end-verified auxiliary channel that would let them be dropped.

Read StrataLaurel/Tests/DiscardBackstop.lean (1175B) in full: real #guard assertions testing ensureDiscardDiagnosed. Read StrataLaurel/Tests/UseCases/ThrowAnyValue.lean (head, 3190B): #eval testLaurelVerification <| #strata program Laurel; datatype JsValue {...} with explanatory prose modeling JS 'throw any value' semantics. Read StrataLaurel/Tests/EndToEndTests/Resolution/InferType.lean in full (333B, the smallest file in the unit): #eval testLaurelExecution {...} <| #strata program Laurel; procedure foo() opaque { <?> //^^^ error: could not infer type }; #end -- a genuine DSL type-inference test. Read StrataLaurel/Tests/EndToEndTests/Execution/StmtExpr/Expr/Operators/Assert.lean (441B) in full: genuine DSL test asserting Laurel `assert` semantics. Read StrataLaurel/Implementation/Checked.lean (1451B) in full: real docstring, `namespace Strata.Laurel.Checked`, `#guard_msgs in derive_laurel_ops coreDefinitionsForLaurel` (a metaprogram command generating declarations, outside the theorem/def/... keyword set). All confirm the DSL classification and are retained.

Read Strata/DL/Imperative.lean and StrataLaurel/Implementation/Grammar.lean (341B) in full: both are only a copyright header, `module -- shake: keep-all`, and `public import` lines -- pure navigation umbrellas, retained per FILTER-007.

Listed all 16 files under docs/verso/ on disk; 8 are outside this unit's file-to-review list (DDMDoc.lean, DDMDocMain.lean, IRTranslationPhilosophyDocMain.lean, LangDefDocMain.lean, LaurelDesignerGuideMain.lean, LaurelImplementorGuideMain.lean, LaurelUserGuideMain.lean, TransformsDocMain.lean) -- unchanged since the last review, so their existing disposition is not mine to alter and none is named in this unit's 'Exclusions already in force' list.

Read the 8 in-scope docs/verso/*.lean files. Ran grep -cE 'theorem|lemma|def |structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom|elab|#doc|block_extension|#eval|%doc' on each: IRTranslationPhilosophyDoc.lean 18, LangDefDoc.lean 23, LangSemDoc.lean 24, LangSemDocMain.lean 2, LaurelDesignerGuide.lean 37, LaurelImplementorGuide.lean 24, LaurelUserGuide.lean 67, TransformsDoc.lean 10 keyword-lines -- none is declaration/doc-command-free.

Read the bodies of LangDefDoc.lean, LangSemDoc.lean, LaurelDesignerGuide.lean, LaurelImplementorGuide.lean, IRTranslationPhilosophyDoc.lean, TransformsDoc.lean: each is a Verso `#doc (Manual)` literate-documentation module that imports real semantic/implementation modules (e.g. Strata.DL.Imperative.Cmd, Strata.DL.Lambda.LExpr, StrataLaurel.Implementation.LaurelAST) and carries substantial original technical prose (design philosophy, language semantics, Laurel usage guidance) not duplicated in any other indexed file -- unique searchable content under FILTER-004's option 2 test (no exact duplicate exists) and not covered by option 1 (these are not declaration-free). Read docs/verso/LaurelUserGuide.lean beyond the header (lines 25-120 of 154765B total): it defines a real `block_extension Block.«example»` Verso extension and an `@[code_block] def laurel` command whose docstring states it 'parse-checks its contents at doc-elaboration time so a syntax error in an example fails the documentation build', using StrataLaurel.Implementation's real parser -- i.e. every Laurel code sample embedded in this guide is checked against the live implementation. All 7 of these files are retained: they hold unique prose plus, in LaurelUserGuide.lean's case, genuine checked declarations.

Read docs/verso/LangSemDocMain.lean in full (341B, the only trivial render-entry-point wrapper among the 8 in-scope verso files -- the other 7 such Main.lean wrappers are out of scope): copyright header, `import LangSemDoc`, `def config : RenderConfig where ...`, `def main := manualMain (%doc LangSemDoc) (config := config)`. This is boilerplate IO/render wiring with no formal declaration, statement, proof, or interface of its own; every piece of content it renders (the actual doc prose and code) lives entirely in the retained LangSemDoc.lean. This is structurally identical to the already-forced exclusion of Scripts/StrataTestMain.lean in this same unit ('only the IO entry point ... the actual ... declarations and verification code remain in retained ... modules'), so the same FILTER-004 condition-1 reasoning (no formal-mathematical declaration + full auxiliary-channel retention in the paired file) applies here and it is excluded.

Read the head and doc comments of editors/CoreSyntaxGen.lean (18101B) and editors/GenSyntax.lean (1931B): the former is real generation logic deriving VSCode/Emacs syntax highlighting from the Core DDM grammar object (open Strata CoreDDM StrataDDM StrataDDM.Elab, real declarations processing structured SyntaxDef data); the latter is its CLI driver. Read StrataLaurel/Scripts/LaurelJavaGen.lean (1141B) in full: a real `private def laurelFiles : GeneratedFiles := getIonSerializer% Strata.Laurel.Program ...` generating Java AST source via the Ion serializer macro. Read the head of StrataLaurel/Scripts/LaurelToCBMC.lean (5076B): a genuine pipeline script invoking Strata's full Laurel-to-CBMC verification chain (parse, translate to Core, type-check, generate GOTO JSON, invoke symtab2gb/goto-cc/goto-instrument/cbmc). All four are real, non-junk formalization tooling and are retained.
